verses.text: A psalm of David, written when he ran away from his son Absalom. LORD, I have so many enemies! So many people are rising up against me.
Many people are saying about me, "God will not rescue him." Selah.
But you, LORD, are a shield that protects me all around. You give me honour, and you lift up my head.
I cry out loud to the LORD, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah.
I lie down and sleep, and I wake up again, because the LORD keeps me safe.
I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who surround me to attack me.
Get up, LORD! Save me, my God! You have slapped all my enemies across the face. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
Rescue comes from the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
